title: Pilot plan + rollout gates for PLG→sales signals (cohort, gates, weekly review)
creator: Nikhil Sharma
description:
Goal
Define the pilot cohort + rollout gates for PLG→sales signal routing so we can test with low risk, tune thresholds, and have a clear go/no-go for broad rollout.

Context
We’re turning self-serve usage + intent signals into actionable HubSpot tasks/sequence enrollments. The main risk is false positives (spam/outreach quality) and reliability issues (late signals, duplicates, HubSpot API failures).

Pilot scope (v0)
- Signal types included in pilot:
  1) Sustained spend growth + high absolute spend (7/14/30d windows)
  2) Rate-limit friction (repeated 429s / quota hits)
  3) Concurrency/throughput pressure (burst + sustained)
  4) Security intent (docs/console engagement: SSO/SAML, audit logs, SOC2 pages)
  5) Region/residency intent (EU-only / data residency pages)
  6) Explicit high-intent actions (pricing page repeat visits + “contact sales” submit)
- Out of scope for pilot (v0): model-routing failures as a standalone trigger; partner/channel leads; “support ticket exists” as a primary trigger (can be used as context only).

Pilot cohort selection
Target cohort size: 50–75 companies (enough volume to observe at least ~15–25 outreach attempts/week without overwhelming SDR/AEs).

Inclusion criteria (must meet at least one)
- Clear usage threshold crossed (spend or tokens) for ≥ 14 days OR repeated rate-limit friction over 7 days
- Security/residency intent events ≥ 2 distinct sessions / 7 days (to avoid single click noise)
- Explicit “contact sales” event OR pricing page repeat visits (>=3 in 14d) + any secondary signal

Exclusion / suppression criteria (hard blocks)
- Existing open opportunity in HubSpot OR in an active sales sequence
- Current enterprise / Dedicated account with assigned CSM motion (route to CSM/AE manually outside the pilot)
- Explicit opt-out / unsubscribe flag (marketing or sales)
- Sensitive accounts flagged by Security/Legal (restricted outreach) — require explicit approval by Stephanie Nguyen or Lukas Meyer + Security

Ownership rules for pilot (simplified)
- NA: Stephanie Nguyen’s team; EMEA: Lukas Meyer’s team
- SDR coverage: Grace O’Connor program, with Rohan Mehta as primary pilot operator
- Solutions Engineering: Markus Klein to provide 2x weekly office hours for escalations (latency/SLO, Dedicated sizing, security questionnaires)

Operational mechanics
- Routing uses an allowlist for pilot domains (feature-flagged). No automatic routing for non-allowlist domains.
- Dedupe/cool-down rules for pilot:
  - Same company + same signal type: suppress for 14 days after first emission (unless signal severity increases to “high”, then emit one upgrade event)
  - Cross-signal spam control: max 2 tasks created per company per 30 days during pilot

Rollout gates (go/no-go)
We will not expand beyond pilot allowlist until all gates below are met for 2 consecutive weeks.

Quality gates (false positives)
- False-positive rate (FPR) ≤ 15% overall, measured as: % of outreaches where AE/SDR marks “Not relevant / clearly not a fit / wrong persona / no product need” within 7 days of task creation.
- High-severity false positives (complaint, negative response, “do not contact”) ≤ 2% of outreaches.
- Duplicate outreach incidents caused by duplicate signal events: ≤ 0.5% of tasks created.

Reliability gates (pipeline + CRM)
- Signal freshness: p95 time from qualifying event window close → HubSpot task created ≤ 30 minutes (pilot target). p99 ≤ 2 hours.
- HubSpot write success: ≥ 99% of writes succeed within 15 minutes (including retries). Any dead-letter queue entries must be < 10/day and auto-retried within 24h.
- Idempotency: duplicate timeline events for identical idempotency key = 0 (must be enforced at writer layer).

Volume gates (sales capacity)
- Generated tasks: 15–35 per week during pilot (if above 35, tighten thresholds; if below 10, broaden inclusion criteria).
- SDR SLA: first touch within 1 business day for “high intent” signals (contact sales/security intent), 2 business days otherwise.

Outcome gates (early business signal)
- Meeting set rate: ≥ 20% of outreaches lead to a meeting scheduled within 14 days (pilot-level expectation; adjust after week 1 data).
- Qualified conversion: ≥ 10% to SQL (as defined by Sales Ops) within 21 days.

Weekly review process (standing cadence)
- Weekly 45-min review meeting (owner: Chris Osei)
  - Attendees: Nikhil Sharma, Logan Wright, David Kim, Isabelle Laurent, Grace O’Connor, Stephanie Nguyen, Lukas Meyer, Jasmine Liu, Markus Klein
  - Pre-read (sent 24h prior):
    - Volume by signal type, segment, geo
    - FPR sample (top 10 “bad” + top 10 “good” examples)
    - Latency + HubSpot write failures
    - Meetings created + notes on objections
  - Decision log: threshold changes, copy changes, suppression additions, any signal paused via feature flag

Required instrumentation for pilot readout
- HubSpot task property “PLG Signal Type” (enum) and “Signal Severity” (low/med/high)
- Outcome logging: SDR disposition within 7 days (Connected / Not now / Not a fit / Bad data / Opt-out)
- Linkouts: timeline event includes top 3 reasons (e.g., “30d spend +74%”, “429s over 7d”, “EU residency docs engaged”)

Deliverables from this ticket
- Pilot cohort list requirements + selection process (who provides list, by when)
- Rollout gate thresholds + measurement definitions
- Weekly review agenda + pre-read template + owner assignments

Acceptance criteria
- Pilot cohort approach agreed by Sales + CS + Security
- Gates are explicitly measurable with data sources identified (HubSpot properties + pipeline metrics)
- Weekly review process scheduled + owners confirmed

comments: 2025-02-11 (Chris Osei): Drafted initial gates. Biggest open question: do we use 15% FPR threshold or start at 20% given early thresholds are conservative? Suggest start 15% to protect brand; can loosen only if volume too low.

2025-02-12 (Grace O’Connor): +1 on conservative start. Please cap tasks per company; early sequences got weird when multiple triggers fired. Also want a required disposition field in HubSpot to make FPR measurable.
2025-02-13 (Isabelle Laurent): Confirmed we can add required task properties + a disposition dropdown for the pilot workflow. Need final enum values by end of week to avoid rework.

2025-02-14 (Dr. Aisha Rahman): Security approval contingent on: no user-level identifiers in outbound events; restrict sensitive account visibility; add opt-out propagation from marketing suppression lists. Marking security_review_required = true until those are verified in writer payload.

2025-02-18 (Logan Wright): Engineering can meet p95 30m freshness if we refresh 7/14/30d windows hourly. If we go to 15m cadence, compute costs rise; prefer hourly for pilot. Flagging that p95 definition should not be ‘event time’ (varies), but ‘window refresh completion time’.
2025-02-19 (David Kim): HubSpot rate limit note: keep batch sizes small and retry with backoff. Also recommended go/no-go gate on write failure rate. Added ‘DLQ <10/day’ suggestion.

2025-02-24 (Stephanie Nguyen): NA coverage confirmed. For “contact sales” signal, route directly to AE + create SDR assist task (don’t enroll sequence automatically). For rate-limit pain, SDR can run sequence as normal.
2025-02-25 (Lukas Meyer): EMEA note: residency intent should route to EMEA even if company HQ unknown. Use usage region (eu-west) as tie-breaker when domain enrichment is missing.

2025-03-03 (Chris Osei): Pilot cohort locked at 62 companies (mix of spend-growth + rate-limit + security intent). Weekly review invite sent. Added cap: max 2 tasks/company/30d to reduce spam. Ready to move ticket to Done; gates will be revisited after first 2 weeks of data.
